description: In the OpenCAD system (http://localhost), log in as admin (admin@opencad.local / Admin123!). After logging in you will see the main dashboard with department buttons. Click the ADMIN button to access the admin panel where pending user access requests are listed. There is a pending user account for 'Sarah Mitchell' (sarah.mitchell@opencad.local) who applied to join the Los Santos Police Department. Click the 'Approve' button next to her name to approve her access so she can use the system.
